dogecoin.text: Google search data indicates that #dogecoin  has attracted more attention than any cryptocurrency in this bull market, and is the only crypto to have ever surpassed #BTC in Google search volume in the US https://t.co/LTwhk1AuI3

In the US, the recent surge in interest in crypto has been led by Dogecoin. Along with the US, Turkey is the only other nation where over the past 30 days Google searches for 'dogecoin' outpaced searches for 'bitcoin.' https://t.co/ScwN54SCbL

Despite the hype brought to #Dogecoin by @elonmusk and the coin hitting a ~93B USD market cap in May, GitHub shows the network has seen limited developer work and has not seen the type of development activity typically associated with projects striving for more genuine adoption.
